hypothesis: In the deadline-sensitive transient-cue regime, active-minus-sham persisted-effect contrast under OBSERVATION_REACTIVE differs from FIXED_REPLAY by at least 0.50 absolute success-rate points; interaction magnitude in stable and no-information controls is at most 0.10.

randomized_order.algorithm: four cyclic rotations of canonical cell order, repeated twice; deterministic per-regime PRNG shuffle assigns the 8 balanced orders to the 8 seeds

simulator.reset: fresh state for each cell; identical regime/seed shares exogenous cue and reset id
simulator.active_observation: blocks the single event loop from request/start until completion; both levels return the current declared cue evidence
simulator.reactive_rule: urgent evidence: reobserve exactly once only if confirmation plus persistence can finish before task deadline and cue validity; otherwise yield. none evidence: use the fixed nominal action time. Reobserve returns current declared evidence.
simulator.success: independently auditable persisted effect time is at or before the task deadline

gates.method: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only if all 96 rows, reset/matching/order/timing/decision/input-release/effect receipts audit and all 4 frozen corruptions are rejected
gates.result: INTERACTION_SUPPORTED_SCOPED only if positive regime meets min interaction and both controls meet equivalence bound; else NO_INTERACTION_SCOPED or UNCERTAIN

limitations: No inference about real GUI observation cost, controller quality, safety, or user tempo.
